hero.name: Daan
hero.prompt: Photorealistic next-gen video game character render of Daan, a Dutch pizza delivery rider in his late 20s, short messy blond hair, light stubble, red bomber jacket over a white t-shirt, black jeans, white sneakers, open-face helmet under his arm, standing beside a red electric delivery scooter with a plain insulated box on the back, Dutch brick village street at golden hour, full body, cinematic depth of field, vertical 9:16. No text, no logos.

style_prefix: Photorealistic next-gen open-world video game cutscene set in a real Dutch village, golden-hour light, slightly heightened colours, cinematic camera. No on-screen text, no logos, no subtitles.
keyframe_instruction: Use the location photo as the exact background and camera position. Place the character from the reference image into it as described. Keep every building, sign and road marking of the photo unchanged. Photorealistic game-cutscene look, golden-hour light. Do not add text or logos.

shots.name: the-call
shots.keyframe_prompt: The character leans on his red delivery scooter parked on the pavement in front of the pizzeria, looking at the phone in his hand.
shots.video_prompt: His phone buzzes, he reads it, smirks, pockets it and puts on his helmet. Slow push-in.
shots.audio_prompt: Phone buzz, quiet village street, a distant church bell.

shots.name: pickup
shots.keyframe_prompt: The pizzeria door is open and the character steps out of it carrying two stacked plain pizza boxes, his red delivery scooter waiting at the kerb with its box lid open.
shots.video_prompt: He strides to the scooter, slides the boxes into the delivery box and snaps the lid shut. Handheld camera at waist height.
shots.audio_prompt: Door swinging, box latch click, a man's voice from inside shouting 'Rijden!'.

shots.name: launch
shots.keyframe_prompt: Seen from behind and low, the character sits on his red delivery scooter in the right-hand lane of the brick street, about to ride away from the camera.
shots.video_prompt: Low rear tracking shot as he accelerates down the brick village street beside a red cycle lane, passing terraced houses, parked bicycles and a small hatchback with a soft, unreadable yellow number plate. He keeps to the right side of the road.
shots.audio_prompt: Electric scooter whine rising, tyres on brick paving.

shots.name: barriers-close
shots.keyframe_prompt: The character on his red delivery scooter rolls up to the stop line of the level crossing, seen from behind and slightly to the side. The barriers are still up.
shots.video_prompt: The two red warning lights start flashing alternately and the red and white barriers lower. He brakes smoothly and stops well before the line, puts one foot down, checks his watch and exhales. A cyclist stops beside him. He stays completely still behind the closed barrier.
shots.audio_prompt: Level crossing warning bell ringing, soft brake squeak, a bicycle bell.

shots.name: train-passes
shots.keyframe_prompt: Low camera behind the character, who waits on his red delivery scooter with one foot on the ground in front of the closed red and white barriers, warning lights lit.
shots.video_prompt: A yellow Dutch passenger train with blue bands rushes past on the tracks beyond the barriers, left to right, wind tugging his jacket. The train clears, the barriers rise fully, and only then does he pull away across the crossing.
shots.audio_prompt: Train roar and rail clatter, the warning bell stops, electric scooter whine.

shots.name: bulb-fields
shots.keyframe_prompt: The character rides his red delivery scooter along a narrow straight road between rows of red and yellow tulips in full bloom, a ditch beside the road, flat Dutch landscape, low sun flaring. Side view from a distance.
shots.video_prompt: Drone-style side tracking shot keeping pace with the scooter along the tulip fields.

shots.name: delivery
shots.keyframe_prompt: The character stands at the front door of the brick terraced house holding two plain pizza boxes, his red delivery scooter parked behind him on the street.
shots.video_prompt: The door opens, he hands the boxes to a delighted customer, the top lid opens on a steaming pizza. Slow push-in on the pizza.
